name: Silver Creek County Fire & Rescue
summary: Silver Creek County Fire & Rescue VR Simulator is a realistic, open-world firefighting game set in fictional Silver Creek County, Florida. Players can explore fire stations, operate emergency vehicles, respond to calls, and use firefighting equipment through immersive VR interactions. Featuring realistic fire trucks, interactive controls, firefighter uniforms, and emergency response systems, SCFR is being developed in Unity for Meta Quest headsets.
